title: DiRT Rally 2.0 stages
keys: length_m is the track length DiRT sends (UDP field 61) and start_z the car's z at the start line, both as dr2_logger recorded them; a run matches within 2 m of length and 15 m of start z. start_z_alt is the same start as dirt-rally-time-recorder recorded it.
notes: Stage names, lengths and start z from dr2_logger (adapted from dirt-rally-time-recorder); every rally length is the same float in both, start z agrees within 1 m for most stages (up to 18.6 m: Taylor Farm Sprint, Rockton Plains, Chandlers Creek). Surfaces are per location (the source tables have none). reverse_of is set only where the name says so; many other stages are reverses of each other in the game. Rallycross and DirtFish are from dr2_logger alone.
